entries: The Multi Target Assassination gta v
Lester has Franklin eliminate four jurors connected to a Redwood Cigarettes lawsuit. The mission can be used with LCN investments for major profit.
Franklin kills Facade CEO Jackson Skinner for Lester, creating another stock-market opportunity.
Franklin poses as a bus driver to kill investor Isaac Penny. Unlike most assassination plays, the notable stock opportunity comes after the mission.
Franklin attacks a construction site to kill developer Enzo Bonelli for Lester, with GoldCoast stock tied to the mission's market effect.
Los Santos is the main urban area of GTA V, inspired by Los Angeles. It contains Downtown, Vinewood, South Los Santos, beaches, industrial districts, major government buildings, and LSIA.
Blaine County is the rural northern part of the map, containing Sandy Shores, Grapeseed, Paleto Bay, the Grand Senora Desert, Mount Chiliad, forests, and the Alamo Sea.
Downtown Los Santos is the city's central business district, including areas such as Pillbox Hill, Mission Row, Legion Square, and Textile City.
Pillbox Hill is a Downtown district containing major skyscrapers and institutions, including the FIB and IAA headquarters area.
Vinewood is the entertainment-industry district inspired by Hollywood, associated with studios, celebrities, nightlife, and the Vinewood sign.
Vinewood Hills is an affluent hillside residential area north of central Los Santos, home to mansions and the Galileo Observatory area.
Rockford Hills is an affluent incorporated city inspired by Beverly Hills, with luxury shopping, mansions, and locations such as Portola Drive.
Richman is a wealthy western Los Santos neighborhood that includes the Los Santos Golf Club and large estates.
Del Perro is a coastal city inspired by Santa Monica, centered on Del Perro Beach and the Del Perro Pier amusement area.
Vespucci Beach is a beach neighborhood inspired by Venice Beach, with the boardwalk, Muscle Sands, canals nearby, and multiple story activities.
Vespucci Canals is a canal-lined residential area inspired by Venice Canals, west of central Los Santos.
Little Seoul is a Koreatown-inspired district with Korean businesses and criminal activity, also used by the Triads and Korean Mob in parts of the story world.
La Puerta is a southwestern industrial and transport district near Maze Bank Arena, docks, highways, and the airport approaches.
Cypress Flats is an industrial East Los Santos district with warehouses, factories, rail infrastructure, and gang activity.
La Mesa is an East Los Santos industrial district with freeway access, warehouses, and Lester's garment factory area.
Murrieta Heights is an eastern Los Santos district mixing industrial and residential zones, used in several missions and chases.
Davis is a South Los Santos city strongly associated with the Ballas and gang conflict around Grove Street and surrounding blocks.
Chamberlain Hills is a South Los Santos neighborhood and major Families territory, closely tied to Franklin and Lamar.
Strawberry is Franklin's early home neighborhood and part of the broader South Los Santos gang environment.
Rancho is a South/East Los Santos neighborhood strongly associated with the Los Santos Vagos and some Aztecas activity.
where is Los Santos International Airport
Los Santos International Airport is the major airport at the southern edge of Los Santos, with runways, terminals, hangars, and frequent mission use.
where is Port of Los Santos
Port of Los Santos is the large industrial seaport in southern Los Santos, with docks, container yards, cranes, Elysian Island, and Merryweather activity.
Terminal is a Port of Los Santos industrial area with cargo terminals, rail lines, warehouses, and docks.
Elysian Island is an industrial island in the Port of Los Santos containing docks, storage facilities, and the Merryweather naval facility.
Sandy Shores is a desert town on the Alamo Sea and Trevor's main home area, surrounded by trailers, airfield facilities, and criminal businesses.
Grapeseed is an agricultural town in Blaine County with farms, dirt roads, McKenzie Field, and the O'Neil Ranch nearby.
Paleto Bay is a small northwestern coastal town at the base of Mount Chiliad, used prominently in the Paleto Score storyline.
Harmony is a small community along Route 68 in the Grand Senora Desert, known for roadside businesses and vehicle services.
Grand Senora Desert is the large desert region across central Blaine County, surrounding Sandy Shores, Harmony, airfields, and many off-road routes.
Alamo Sea is the large inland lake in Blaine County, inspired by the Salton Sea and surrounded by Sandy Shores, Galilee, and desert settlements.
Mount Chiliad is the highest mountain in San Andreas, accessible by roads, trails, and cable car, and associated with hiking, parachuting, and the Chiliad mystery.
Mount Gordo is a mountain on the northeastern coast of Blaine County, known for wilderness, trails, and the ghost-related Easter egg.
Raton Canyon is a rugged canyon and river area in northern Blaine County used for outdoor activities and off-road travel.
where is Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness
Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness is the mountainous wilderness around Mount Chiliad, including forests, hiking routes, and the Altruist Camp.
Paleto Forest is a dense forest south of Paleto Bay, used in Predator and other rural encounters.
Fort Zancudo is the heavily guarded military base in western Blaine County. Entering without authorization usually triggers a high wanted level and military resistance.
Sandy Shores Airfield is a desert airstrip Trevor takes over during Nervous Ron. It becomes useful for aircraft storage and Trevor's operations.
McKenzie Field is a small airfield in Grapeseed that Trevor can purchase in Story Mode for arms-trafficking activities.
where is Humane Labs and Research
Humane Labs and Research is a secured research facility in the San Chianski Mountain Range, central to the mission Monkey Business.
Union Depository is the high-security financial institution targeted in The Big Score, the protagonists' largest planned robbery.
